description: §44.3 — a `.prepare()` whose result is the CPS-RETURN continuation of a server handler (`@cell = ?{...}.prepare()` assigned to the returnVar of a CPS-split route) SHALL be compile error E-SQL-006. This pins the emit-server CPS-return sub-branch (`stmt.sqlNode` → emitLogicNode), a distinct opts object from the main handler-body loop; before the fix that inline opts omitted the `.prepare()` sink, so the diagnostic was silently dropped on this sub-path (a silent partial fix) while the runtime IIFE `const _scrml_cps_return = (()=>{throw ...})()` still emitted.
rationale: The CPS-return sub-branch lowers the continuation `?{...}` via emitLogicNode with its own opts; it now threads the function-scoped `_sqlPrepareErrors` sink (drained deduped at the tail), so emit-logic case "sql" (method===prepare) surfaces E-SQL-006 here too.
